definitions.explanation: A vision condition caused by an irregularly curved cornea or lens, resulting in blurred or distorted vision at all distances.

examples.japanese: {乱視|らんし}があるので、コンタクトレンズは{特注|とくちゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Because I have astigmatism, I need custom-made contact lenses.

examples.japanese: {乱視|らんし}を{矯正|きょうせい}するメガネをかけている。
examples.english: I wear glasses that correct my astigmatism.

examples.japanese: {検眼|けんがん}で{乱視|らんし}の{度合|どあ}いを{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: The eye exam measured the degree of my astigmatism.

notes:
USAGE: {乱視|らんし} literally means "disordered vision." It can occur along with nearsightedness or farsightedness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{乱視|らんし}がある (to have astigmatism)
・{乱視|らんし}を{矯正|きょうせい}する (to correct astigmatism)
・{乱視用|らんしよう}コンタクト (toric contact lenses)
・{乱視|らんし}の{度数|どすう} (astigmatism prescription)

OTHER VISION CONDITIONS:
・{近視|きんし} - nearsightedness (myopia)
・{遠視|えんし} - farsightedness (hyperopia)
・{老眼|ろうがん} - presbyopia

TREATMENT: {乱視|らんし} is typically corrected with glasses ({眼鏡|めがね}), toric contact lenses, or refractive surgery ({屈折矯正手術|くっせつきょうせいしゅじゅつ}).
